*   **Time Complexity:** Linear with respect to the number of voxels processed, as each voxel culling decision is independent and assigned to a single thread [S1].

The evidence explicitly states in Section 4.2 that 'Our oracle kernel is assigned a single thread per voxel, and each voxel culling decision is independent of any other.' This directly supports the claim that each voxel culling decision is independent and assigned to a single thread. Regarding the time complexity, since the number of threads equals the number of voxels (one per voxel) and the decisions are independent (no inter-thread dependencies mentioned that would cause serialization or variable workloads beyond the loop over cameras), the processing scales linearly with the number of voxels processed.
